ng.adj_items_text: Reconciliation (Note 4, in € million): EBITDA (adjusted) 56.1; Depreciation, amortization and impairment (15.9); Other income and expenses (Note 9) (3.8); Other * (5.7); OPERATING PROFIT 30.7. * In the 6-month period ended June 30, 2024, the "Other" line mainly comprises the IFRS 2 share-based payment expense for €2.9 million and non-recurring advisory and strategy fees relating to the Group's external growth policy (recorded in Other operating expenses) for €2.0 million. Section 3.5: increase in EBITDA (adjusted) of €22.1 million ... other restatements totaling €3.3 million (M&A costs and IFRS 2 expense). Other income and expenses (Note 9): IPO costs (3,853); Company acquisition costs 0; Other (10); total (3,863) € thousand.
ng.definition: The Group defines EBITDA (adjusted) as operating profit, less (i) additions net of reversals to depreciation, amortization and impairment of non-current assets; (ii) non-recurring income and expenses as presented in the Group's consolidated income statement within "Other income" and "Other expenses", and (iii) the impact of items that do not reflect ordinary operating performance (in particular business reorganization and adaption costs, costs relating to acquisition and external growth transactions, as well as the IFRS 2 share-based payment expense). [Note 4] EBIT (adjusted): as defined in Section 7.4 of the 2023 Registration Document (excluding depreciation and amortization corresponding to purchase price allocations). [Key figures note 3 / section 3.6]

All term loans (A1, A2, Acquisition Facility), the RCF commitments and the A, B and Additional (2023) bonds were repaid / redeemed in full at the IPO (June 2024). Business report 4.4: redemption of bond debt €228.7 million and repayment of senior debt €71.9 million; new €250.0 million term loan.

extra.guidance: Outlook for 2024 (section 7): Based on the strong revenue growth in the first half of the year, the Company confirms its forecast outlook of organic revenue growth at the high end of the 15%-20% range and of around 30% total revenue growth including the 12-month contribution of acquisitions in 2024.
extra.events: Conversion from SAS to SA on 2024-05-31. IPO on Euronext Paris (compartment A, ticker EXENS) on 2024-06-07 by private placement at a technical reference price of €20.00; 9,000,001 new shares issued (€180.0 million gross); over-allotment option (max 2,625,002 additional sale shares) exercised in full on 2024-06-12. IPO costs €12.2 million: €7.8 million in equity (deducted from share premiums), €4.4 million in the income statement (€3.9 million in Other expenses; the balance in financial expenses / operating lines). Refinancing: all legacy loans and bonds repaid; new €250 million Term Loan B and €100 million RCF. Liquidity agreement with Kepler Cheuvreux signed 2024-07-07 (€2 million). HLD Europe remains the majority shareholder. Ten production sites.
extra.derivatives: SWAP €170 million to 2024-12-31 (BNP); CAP €40 million to 2024-12-31 (BNP); FX hedge GBP 20.2 million to 2024-09-11 (CIC, Centronic consideration).

notes: All statement values converted from € thousand to € million (÷1,000, 3 decimals); APM tables as printed in € million. Signs as printed. SELF-CHECKS: IS, segment, cash-flow and balance-sheet checks pass within tolerance (sums of printed lines differ from printed subtotals by at most €1-2 thousand of rounding: CF operating lines sum to 39,801 vs printed 39,802; financing lines sum to 87,042 vs 87,043; opening cash 15,458 + 107,706 = 123,164 vs closing 123,166; balance-sheet non-current assets sum to 468,465 vs 468,466). EPS check ni/wsh = 2.864/32.51m = +0.09 does NOT equal the printed basic EPS of -0.07: Note 12 deducts a preferential dividend attributable to A preferred shares of €5,149 thousand, giving net profit attributable to the Company of -€2,285 thousand; -2.285/32.510681m = -0.07 (check passes on that basis). Weighted average ordinary shares 32,510,681 reflects the pre-IPO share structure (ordinary shares, A / R1 / R2 / R3 / O' / A' preferred shares) and the June 2024 reorganisation: 15-Mar-2024 issue of 205,795 R1 preferred; 6-Jun-2024 issue of 195,920 R1 preferred, par value of ordinary shares raised from €0.01 to €0.17, cancellation of 45,581,016 ordinary shares and par value raised to €0.425; 11-Jun-2024 issue of 208,000 O', 312,000 A' and 778,348 R1 preferred, 63,145 new ordinary shares with cancellation of 992,149 A preferred, 264,059 new ordinary shares with cancellation of 264,526 ordinary, cancellation of all 119,499,391 preferred shares against 11,332,529 new ordinary shares, and 9,000,001 new ordinary shares in the IPO. Shares in issue at 30-Jun-2024: 50,782,552 ordinary shares of €0.425 (share capital €21,582,584.60); no treasury shares; no dilutive instruments after conversion of the preferred shares. BRIDGE: the H1 2024 report prints a top-down reconciliation only (adj. EBITDA 56.1 - D&A 15.9 - other income/expenses 3.8 - other 5.7 = OP 30.7); EBITDA (50.4), the split of 'Other' into share-based payments (2.9) and non-recurring costs (2.8), D&A excluding PPA (10.0) and PPA amortisation (5.9) are printed only as comparatives in the H1 2025 report (see H1-25.json py.ng). 'oth_adj' 5.7 is the printed 'Other' line; 'sbc' 2.9 is from its footnote; computed EBITDA = 30.7 + 15.9 + 3.8 = 50.4 (not written). ADJUSTED EBIT DISCREPANCY: the key figures table (p.4) prints EBIT (adjusted) of 43.2 (23.1% of sales) for H1 2024, while section 3.6 states 'EBIT (adjusted) is €46.1 million, up €18.9 million year-on-year' (27.2 + 18.9 = 46.1; consistent with adj. EBITDA 56.1 less D&A ex-PPA 10.0, and with the H1 2025 report's comparative of 46.1 / 24.7%). ng.adj_ebit records 46.1; the key-figures value is kept in ng.adj_ebit_keyfigures_table (43.2) and ng.adj_ebit_pct (23.1) is the key-figures percentage. D&A: Note 8 total (15,499) feeds the cash flow statement; the asset notes show amortisation of intangibles (9,822), depreciation of PP&E (4,459) and of right-of-use assets (1,552) - the IFRS 16 line in Note 8 is (1,244). Business report 4.1 cites D&A of (15.8) and additions net of disposals of 17.6. CASH: cash and cash equivalents 123,166 = cash 103,166 + bank deposits with notice up to three months 20,000; no overdraft. BALANCE SHEET comparative: the business report section 4 tables are headed 'June 30, 2023' but the figures printed (468.5/463.7, 192.7/177.3, 123.2/15.5, 784.3/656.4; 382.0/204.1, 290.6/342.3, 111.7/110.1) are the 31-December-2023 statement of financial position; no 30-June-2023 balance sheet is published. Net debt 136.8 / leverage 1.28x (unaudited) per key figures and Note 23; the adjusted EBITDA used for the ratio is not printed. Other income/expenses: Note 9 total (3,863) = IPO costs (3,853) + other (10), presented in the income statement as Other income 119 and Other expenses (3,982). Company acquisition costs (2,077 per the H1 2025 report's Note 8 comparative) are inside Other operating expenses (2,261) in 2024, whereas in H1 2023 they were in Other expenses (1,065).
